name: activity
label: Activity
description: Paste concordance lines containing the target word. Gaps are generated automatically. Configure LancsBox X to export only LEFT, NODE and RIGHT columns; three-column tab-separated exports are supported.

fields.name: distractors
fields.label: Global distractors
fields.description: Enter one word or expression per line. The global answer pool also includes the correct words from every Set.

fields.name: word
fields.label: Concordance Word
fields.description: Correct words must be unique across all Sets after Unicode normalization, surrounding-whitespace trimming and case-insensitive comparison. The standard editor does not check duplicates; duplicate words may still be saved.

fields.name: context
fields.label: Context
fields.description: Paste concordance lines containing the target word. Gaps are generated automatically. Supports ordinary KWIC and LancsBox X three-column tab-separated exports (LEFT, NODE, RIGHT). Do not mix formats or insert underscore gaps. Surrounding ordinary KWIC spacing is preserved.

fields.name: category
fields.label: Category
fields.description: One optional category name for this Set. A comma is part of the name, not a category separator. Used only when categories are enabled.

name: behaviour
label: Behavioural settings
description: Standalone lifecycle controls. Retry is available after final results when enabled; Show solution is not used.

fields.name: foundationMessage
fields.label: Activity instructions
fields.default: Select the word or expression that completes each concordance Set.

fields.name: laterAttemptCount
fields.label: Later successes
fields.default: Correct on the third or a later attempt: @count

fields.name: invalidContentDescription
fields.label: Invalid content description
fields.default: The activity is unavailable. The author must correct the following problems.

fields.name: runtimeError
fields.label: Unexpected checking failure
fields.default: Checking is unavailable. Please reload the activity.

fields.name: sequenceEnd
fields.label: End of sequence
fields.default: You have reached the end of this sequence.

fields.name: kwicRegion
fields.label: Scrollable Context label
fields.default: Concordance context. Scroll horizontally to read long lines.

name: validation
label: Author validation text
description: Runtime diagnostic messages. Standard editor saving is not intercepted. Alignment warnings remain deferred.

fields.name: duplicateWord
fields.label: Duplicate correct word error
fields.default: Sets @sets use the same correct word after Unicode normalization, surrounding-whitespace trimming and case-insensitive comparison.

fields.name: noSets
fields.label: No Sets error
fields.default: At least one Set is required.

fields.name: missingWord
fields.label: Missing word error
fields.default: Set @set: A correct word is required.

fields.name: automaticMissingTarget
fields.label: Automatic target missing
fields.default: Set @set, line @line: No safely matched target word. Automatic gaps require a matching occurrence on every nonempty line and grapheme segmentation support.

fields.name: automaticManualGap
fields.label: Manual gap in automatic mode
fields.default: Set @set, line @line: Underscore gaps are unsupported. Paste the original target word.

fields.name: malformedLancsBox
fields.label: Malformed LancsBox row
fields.default: Set @set, line @line: Malformed LancsBox row; expected LEFT, NODE and RIGHT in exactly three tab-separated fields.

fields.name: mixedContextFormats
fields.label: Mixed Context formats
fields.default: Set @set, line @line: Do not mix ordinary KWIC lines and LancsBox rows in one Context.

fields.name: ambiguousLancsBox
fields.label: Ambiguous LancsBox row
fields.default: Set @set, line @line: Ambiguous tabular input; NODE must contain a safe match for the target word. Use LEFT, NODE and RIGHT columns only.
